title: 健康・医療心理学
subtitle: Health and Medical Psychology
educationalGoal:
Students will learn the basic knowledge and skills to provide psychological support in the health care field.
Students must learn:
1.	Stress process and disease in daily life
2.	Psychosocial problems at medical sites
3.	Psychological supportive approach for victims of the disaster
advice:
The course aims to introduce health and medical care from a psychology point of view. Students will discuss psychological support for people who need to improve their mental/physical health. The course gives students advice to improve people's (and their own) health. Students should understand their own health and stress process with relation to experiences in daily life. Students are expected to read the reference book and other books related to stress and stress management.
The course asks students to answer questionnaires about mental health to fully understand their own health.  However, these questionnaires are not mandatory.
This course is subject to the course credit system.
books:
Textbooks: Health and Medical Psychology, koudansya Publishers, Inc.
Reference books: None
Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students need to read books related to stress health care and health behaviors (eating, exercise, sleep, smoking, etc.). In addition, students should find health promotion and medical psychological support in their local community, and should consider what kind of psychological support they want to receive. Students are expected to apply the knowledge of and skills in health/medical psychology to people's (and their own) health care.
